notes.title: Update Version 1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
-Added a better background in shop
-Added a better background in treasure
-Added a better background in main menu
-Added a better background in character select
-Improved character select menu
-You can now unlock perks while leveling up
-Added animation when unlocking perks after leveling up
-P1 no longer shows up on top of player if you are the only player
-P1 no longer shows in UI if you are the only player

notes.title: Weeklong sale and a new update
notes.content:
The new update is now live. It adds some bug fixes as well as new, improved and better looking backgrounds to the game, and a major bug was fixed with the shop. New updates will also be coming in the next few weeks! Stay tuned.

FULLYBROKEN WAY HOME and FULLYBROKEN OLD DAWN will be going on week long sale in a couple of hours, up to 75% off, snatch them before they go out of stock :).

Have a nice day.

notes.title: Update notes for January 22
notes.content:
Today's additions will be a short one but an important one:
[list]
[*]Fixed some really small issues
[*]Set player starting ability to Lighting Strike as it goes better with the starting weapon of axe
[*] Implemented [b]Aim Assist[/b] for Gamepad
[/list]
The game's demo is also being finished it only waits for the approval of Steam.

Have fun!

notes.title: 1.01 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Good day everyone!
The version 1.01 is now live. This changes have been added to the game:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where player dashing towards exit was getting wrong rotation on next level
[*]Fixed wrong stats showing  on character panel
[*]Fixed a bug where unusable items where shown in shop
[*]Fixed a bug where player had an extra starting weapon
[*]Fixed a bug where action text for player 2 was getting text in the wrong color
[*]Added a feature to support "Show Tutorial" toggle value to be saved across runs
[*][b]Added gamepad support[/b]
[/list]

How are you liking the game so far? 
Thank you very much for any feedback.
